No simulador, o motor entrega exatamente: In the simulator, the motor delivers exactly the PD torque: kp × error − kd × velocity. On the robot, the transmission, heating, and firmware change the effective gain and the maximum torque. Lesson 3 (identify) and lesson 4 (limit).
A política decide a 50 Hz; o comando via: The policy decides at 50 Hz; the command travels over the network, and the motor's PD runs at 500 Hz–1 kHz. Every millisecond between the state read and the torque applied counts. Lesson 4.
O coeficiente de atrito do pé com o chão: The friction coefficient between the foot and the floor changes with the surface, the sole, and dust. Below a certain value, the foot slips on stance. Lesson 2.
Bateria trocada, câmera a mais, cabo: a: Swapped battery, an extra camera, a cable: the real mass and center of mass differ from the file. Lesson 2.
O contato do pé com o chão é a parte mai: Foot-ground contact is the most simplified part of any physics engine: stiffness, damping, and sliding are approximations. That is why you validate in more than one engine (lesson 6).
Nenhuma dessas diferenças some. O sim-to: None of these differences go away. Sim-to-real means making the policy robust to them, measuring the ones you can measure, and testing before the floor.

O treino sorteia, a cada robô simulado,: For each simulated robot, training draws parameters inside ranges: friction, mass, pushes, noise. In the Unitree-G1-29dof-Velocity task, this is the EventCfg class in velocity_env_cfg.py.
Como nunca viu o mesmo mundo duas vezes,: Because it never sees the same world twice, the policy learns not to depend on the exact value. The cost: longer training and, sometimes, a more conservative gait.
Para avaliar, sorteie mundos com semente: To evaluate, draw worlds with a fixed seed and count how many the policy handles. Inside the training range, you expect almost all of them; outside, that's where the risk lives.
Sobrevivência = 10 s andando sem a pelve: Survival = 10 s of walking without the pelvis dropping below 0.5 m. It's a count, not a reward value: that's what you can compare across ranges and across policies.
Randomização não é \"mais é melhor\": é: Randomization is not "more is better": it's covering the world where the robot will walk.
